_note: Part-trait table, Game 1 foundation. Each of the 42 part traits gets Might (attack) and Guard (armor); abilities come from parts (roster doc 03). This file starts with the 21 distinct parts used by the 6 founder lines (Snaplings, Spinehoppers excluded here - 6 chosen are the most concretely specified: Bellmaw, Snaplings, Siltmaw, Gravebind Briars, Thorn Choir, Bellowscap Fungi) plus ember_seeds so the rare fire-ability path has a home. Grows to the full 42 as art/breeding lands. might_mod/guard_mod are tuning placeholders. dominance is reserved for the breeding dominance rolls (not implemented yet).
